page_title: OSA 1-1 VIL | Osasuna v Villarreal 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
88' What was Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

88' Great solo effort by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.

85' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
84' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
82' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
80' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aimar Oroz.
79' Substitution. Alejandro Catena leaves the pitch and is replaced by Unai Garcia (Osasuna).
79' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) replacing Ramon Terrats.
78' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Osasuna get a corner.
78' The attendance for today's match is 18385.
78' Osasuna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
76' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
75' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) is able to continue to play.
73' The game is interrupted now, Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
70' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
69' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:5.
67' The Villarreal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
66' Substitution. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) on for Lucas Torro.
66' Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
64' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
63' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alex Baena will be replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal).
63' It's time for a substitution. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) comes on in place of Jorge Cuenca.

61' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
61' Osasuna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
60' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).

57' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Alex Baena slips the ball through to Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
57' The total number of attempts is 6:7.
54' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
52' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
51' Now Villarreal have a corner.

51' Great solo effort by Alex Baena (Villarreal) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Villarreal are going to take it.
49' The ball possession is 43:57.
47' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
41' Neat passing move from Osasuna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Yellow card. Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
35' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Pepe Reina (Villarreal). Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
34' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

33' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Pepe Reina pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ruben Pena finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
28' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

28' Villarreal show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
26' Good movement by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
24' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
23' One of the Osasuna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
22' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Villarreal keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.
17' Marcelino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alexander Sorloth suffers an injury and Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) comes on.
17' Osasuna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

13' Ambitious effort from Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
10' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
8' Villarreal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is caught offside yet again.
3' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
2' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
